stage1.impression: A moody, convincingly warm night room with a good long-bar perspective, pendant pools and a hint of haze, but it reads as CG: smooth untextured concrete floor with hard, overlapping scalloped stool shadows, a perfectly regular row of identical stools, crushed featureless booths on the right, and no sign of life. The red speaker, which should be the hero, is a tiny blob at the vanishing point, half hidden behind the stools, and the bar's fir ceiling is as saturated a red-brown as the speaker itself.

blocking_9: The Ember speaker is readable at a glance as a tall tinted-acrylic horn speaker, unoccluded, at least ~8% of frame width, glowing through its acrylic
The right-hand booths and wall hold detail (no region >10% of frame more than half crushed; booth region median >= 18)
The floor reads as real polished concrete (aggregate, faint staining, soft reflections) with soft, natural shadow edges rather than overlapping hard discs
Stools and props show life: varied stool angles, glasses, a coat, menus visible at full resolution
Ceiling and timber neutral-warm brown rather than saturated red, so the speaker is the only saturated colour
Back-bar acrylic shelves read as thick, with glowing polished edges and bottles catching highlights

defects.what: Ember speaker tiny (~30x42 px of 720) and partly occluded by the stool row; silhouette does not read as a speaker
Floor: hard-edged overlapping disc shadows from the stools under the pendants form a repeating scallop pattern; concrete is smooth and textureless
Booths crushed: lum_median 7.7, crush_pct 29.5; leather and fir caps barely legible
Right wall/rear between booths and listening room nearly black (median 7.9), the frosted screen above the booths is the only thing reading
Stools identical and aligned in a perfect row: repeated copies of one model
Ceiling and beams saturated red-orange (r 38, g 17, b 10), competing with the speaker as the frame's colour
Back-bar acrylic shelves read as thin flat grey sheet; bottles are dim silhouettes without highlights
Proof is soft/smeared at 0.3 scale; denoiser smear on the stools and the speaker

changes.problem: The hero speaker is a tiny red block at the vanishing point, overlapped by the stool row.

evidence.measured: speaker region 30x42 px (4% of frame width), stools cross in front of it at 1:1

changes.expected: Camera moves into the aisle so the stool row clears the listening room; the Ember speaker fills ~8-10% of frame width with its silhouette and tint readable, bar still leading in on the left.

changes.problem: The booths along the right wall are crushed and featureless.

evidence.measured: lum_median 7.7, lum_p95 31.7, crush_pct 29.5 over 16.6% of frame

change.setting: EARF Moon table lamp in each table lamp; candles

changes.expected: Warm pools on each booth table that lift the tan leather and fir caps; booth region median ~20, crush under 12%.

changes.problem: The pendants throw hard, overlapping disc shadows of the stools onto the floor, a repeating scallop that reads as CG.

evidence.measured: floor median 49.5, brighter than the bar top median 57 nearly; at 3x the shadow edges are hard discs in a regular row

change.to: 650.0 W, cone 55.0 deg, spot radius 0.10 m with blend 0.6

changes.expected: Softer, wider pools with penumbrae; the floor falls below the bar top in brightness so the eye goes to the bar and the speaker.

changes.problem: The floor and ceiling surfaces are smooth CG planes with no material scale.

evidence.measured: at 2x the concrete floor is a uniform grey with no aggregate, staining or reflections of the pendants

change.to: polished concrete, roughness ~0.25 with a noise/stain map varying roughness 0.15-0.4 and albedo +/-10%, exposed fine aggregate

changes.expected: Soft, broken reflections of the pendants and the speaker's red glow on the floor; visible aggregate and staining at 1:1.

changes.problem: The fir ceiling and walls are saturated red-orange, so the speaker is not the only colour.
changes.expected: Timber reads warm brown rather than red; the Ember's red stands alone.

changes.problem: The rear right wall between the booths and the listening room falls to black, so the room ends in a void.

change.from: sconce 40.0 W; record wall 3 x 6.0 W
change.to: sconce 110.0 W; record wall 3 x 18.0 W

changes.expected: A dim but legible far wall with texture, framing the listening room and speaker.

changes.problem: The back-bar's acrylic shelves read as thin flat grey sheets and the bottles carry no highlights.

evidence.measured: lum_median 61.8, lum_p95 132.7; shelf edges barely brighter than the wall

changes.expected: Polished shelf edges glow as thick acrylic lines; bottles catch rim highlights.

changes.problem: Identical stools aligned in a perfect row and an empty room read as a showroom render.

evidence.measured: seven stools at identical rotation and spacing; no props legible at proof scale

change.from: stools aligned, props small on the bar
change.to: rotate stools randomly +/-15 deg, pull two out 15 cm, a coat over one stool back, two rocks glasses and a record out of its sleeve on the bar near camera

changes.expected: The row reads as used furniture and the room as lived-in.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Ember speaker larger or move it forward in the room
out_of_scope.why: The speaker and the room layout are fixed; only the camera can make it bigger in frame (c1).
